paragraphs: The reference list. These are the books that the architectural patterns in this deck draw from — read them in roughly the order listed if you're building up the model from scratch; cherry-pick if you're filling in a specific gap. Newman and Kleppmann are the table-stakes baseline; Bellemare is the event-driven deep dive; Khononov on coupling is the synthesis that ties API design to domain modelling. For C++-specific references on the implementation side: the C++ Core Guidelines, Sutter & Alexandrescu's C++ Coding Standards, and two Apache-2.0 companion projects: cpp-statelessness (patterncatalyst.github.io/cpp-statelessness/) on stateless C++ services in containers, and the C++ container optimization tutorial (patterncatalyst.github.io/cpp-container-optimization-tutorial/). The full list, with a publisher link for every title, is on the site's Bibliography page (patterncatalyst.github.io/cloud-native-design-patterns/bibliography/).
